#TodayinBlackHistory, February 12, 2022, LeBron James passes Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for the most combined regular season and playoffs points👏🏾 Congratulations to The GOAT 
@KingJames for becoming the newest NBA's all-time leader in points scored!#BlackHistoryMonth #BlackLivesMatter

Today marks 10 years since the killing of #TrayvonMartin at the hands of George Zimmerman who fatally shot Trayvon Martin while he was walking home unarmed in Sanford, Florida 🙏🏿 His death ignited #BlackLivesMatter, and the struggle continues.
#BlackHistoryMonth ✊🏾 
#RestInPower

It was Happy 1st of March four days ago which began #WomensHistoryMonth, & Disability Awareness Month in Indiana🙌🏾 We continue highlighting Women's History, & sharing Disability Awareness in Indiana🙌🏾 #March2022 #EmployeeAppreciationDay
#BlackLivesMatter #abilitynotdisability
